title: Mallok staging ownership manifest v1
description: The runner exclusive-creates this manifest with an empty resources array before its first remote read or mutation. Zero, one or two resources are valid so every partial-create state remains schema-valid.

x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.authorizationBinding: authorizationSha256 must equal SHA-256 of the exact authorization.json bytes re-read immediately before every remote action.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.resourceIdentityUnique: Across resources, type, id and name values must each be unique. The standard schema enforces at most one resource of each type; runtime additionally enforces unique id and unique name.
x-mallok-runtimeConstraints.appendOnlyPartialState: Before cleanup, resources is append-only and each successful create result must be durably recorded before another remote mutation starts.

authorizationSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact authorization marker bytes used to initialize this manifest.

resources.description: The empty initialized state and one-resource partial state are valid. Runtime additionally requires unique id and name values.
